name: AMASS
description: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes (AMASS), a unified collection of human motion capture datasets represented as articulated body meshes using the SMPL model.
citation: Mahmood, N., Ghorbani, S., Troje, N. F., Pons-Moll, G., & Black, M. J. (2019). AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 5442–5451. https://doi.org/10.1109/ICCV.2019.00554

license.identifier: AMASS dataset license (non-standard; not an SPDX identifier)
license.notes: AMASS is distributed under its own dataset license, not a standard SPDX license identifier. Review and comply with the license and the licenses/terms of the contributing motion-capture datasets; access and permitted uses may be restricted.
